What's new in DuckOS 1.0.63

• You're told as soon as a new DuckOS is out (a notification), not only once a day.
• Settings › Updates: 'Last update' with the time it went on, and the security patch — nothing else in the way.
• Auto update at 2 am: a new DuckOS is installed overnight; the phone restarts to finish only while its screen is off, otherwise it tells you.
